MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL: normal volatility at 27.5% and mixed breadth, with 3/8 sectors positive. Signals are balanced, but weak breadth limits conviction.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology & Telecom leads (1W: +20.96% | 1M: -8.17%), followed by Construction & REIT (1W: +3.40% | 1M: -10.73%); both are in RECOVERY. Banking & Finance is also in RECOVERY (1W: +0.54% | 1M: -4.32%), led by YKBNK (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +2.35%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy & Chemicals is weakest (1W: -4.70% | 1M: -18.76%), followed by Heavy Industry (1W: -3.43% | 1M: -17.37%); both are BELOW TREND. Retail & Food also remains BELOW TREND (1W: -2.12% | 1M: -9.02%).

STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +58.27% | 1M: -8.64%) RECOVERY; TKFEN (1W: +14.07% | 1M: -20.87%) RECOVERY; ENKAI (1W: +7.45% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY. TSKB (1W: +5.04% | 1M: -4.58%) RECOVERY; YKBNK (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +2.35%) ABOVE TREND.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
VESTL (1W: -13.89% | 1M: -38.41%) BELOW TREND; PETKM (1W: -8.58% | 1M: -14.23%) BELOW TREND; GUBRF (1W: -7.79% | 1M: -32.89%) BELOW TREND. SASA (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -22.92%) BELOW TREND; ARCLK (1W: -6.73% | 1M: -17.84%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
KONTR (1W: +58.27% | 1M: -8.64%) RECOVERY is the standout weekly mover, with TKFEN (1W: +14.07% | 1M: -20.87%) RECOVERY a distant second. ENKAI (1W: +7.45% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY and TSKB (1W: +5.04% | 1M: -4.58%) RECOVERY also show strong short-term rebounds.

SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking & Finance is in RECOVERY on sector averages; YKBNK (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +2.35%) and GARAN (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +2.46%) are ABOVE TREND. TSKB (1W: +5.04% | 1M: -4.58%) and ISCTR (1W: +1.23% | 1M: -1.52%) are in RECOVERY, while HALKB (1W: -5.89% | 1M: -9.95%) and AKBNK (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -6.29%) are BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy Industry is BELOW TREND on sector averages, with FROTO (1W: +2.69% | 1M: -11.46%) in RECOVERY and ASELS (1W: +1.26% | 1M: -7.50%) in RECOVERY. EREGL (1W: -5.00% | 1M: -18.02%) and TOASO (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -16.57%) remain BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals is the weakest sector and BELOW TREND on both timeframes. OYAKC (1W: +1.42% | 1M: -10.62%) is in RECOVERY, while TUPRS (1W: -6.58% | 1M: -12.92%), SASA (1W: -7.50% | 1M: -22.92%), and SISE (1W: -1.36% | 1M: -10.50%) are BELOW TREND.

PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a neutral, selective stance: keep risk controlled and avoid broad exposure to sectors with persistent monthly weakness. Favor confirmed relative strength, but treat sharp weekly rebounds as tactical until breadth improves.

NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
Track whether KONTR (1W: +58.27% | 1M: -8.64%) RECOVERY can sustain its surge, and whether TKFEN (1W: +14.07% | 1M: -20.87%) RECOVERY and ENKAI (1W: +7.45% | 1M: -3.15%) RECOVERY extend their rebounds. YKBNK (1W: +2.77% | 1M: +2.35%) ABOVE TREND is a stronger trend-confirmation candidate.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Monitor Technology & Telecom and Construction & REIT for follow-through after strong weekly gains but negative monthly returns. Watch Banking & Finance for confirmation that its modest weekly advance can broaden beyond its leading names.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
No XU100 price levels were supplied, so specific support and resistance levels cannot be stated. Key triggers are a rise above 3/8 positive sectors and volatility easing below 25%; a deterioration toward 2/8 positive sectors or volatility above 40% would increase downside risk.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

The market remains NEUTRAL, with normal 27.5% volatility offset by mixed breadth at 3/8 positive sectors. Technology & Telecom and Construction & REIT lead in a rebound, while Energy & Chemicals and Heavy Industry remain weak; narrow breadth argues for selective positioning and disciplined risk controls.
